## Overview

Standalone notebook/report in the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-)—Classification project predicting customer churn for retention campaigns.

## Problem & Data

Subscription businesses lose revenue when churn is detected too late.

## Approach

Feature engineering on usage/billing data, logistic regression and tree models, precision/recall evaluation.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Churn risk scores prioritizing outreach to high-risk accounts.
